pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/21028

### What is changed and how it works?

Lock mutex around accessing `minCommitTS` during prewrite to avoid data race.

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- No release note.
pr_comments:
@youjiali1995 I remove setting `minCommitTS` to zero.

And I also open https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/9035, so check_txn_status handles async-commit locks specially without checking `currentTS`, callerStartTS` and `minCommitTS`.

review_comments:
The race can happen only in async-commit. Another solution is if it's an async-commit transaction, don't read it and set minCommitTs to 0.

BTW, I find a bug in supporting external consistency. The minCommitTs got from PD is not persisted in TiKV. It can break external consistency in recovery and break the solution above.
If it's an async-commit, we still need to read it. This value can be set to ensure external consistency.
Can you add a test for it?
I haven't found a good way to test this. Let me think...
